name: Church Finances
overview: Scripture teaches that all wealth ultimately belongs to the Lord, as He declares that silver and gold are His (Haggai 2:8). Believers are called to manage resources wisely, avoiding foolish spending and debt (Proverbs 21:20; 22:7), and to faithfully bring tithes into the storehouse to support God's work, with the promise of abundant blessing for obedience (Malachi 3:10). Giving must be done with pure motives, not for human recognition, but to receive reward from the Father in heaven (Matthew 6:1).
